item.title: EU planned to scrap clock changes. Why are they still happening?
item.description: This Sunday the clocks will be turned back again, even though the EU Parliament set abolition in motion at the end of 2019. Why?

item.title: Websites go dark after AI exposes major programming language security flaw
item.description: Government agencies and companies around the world shut down websites Wednesday after two critical flaws came to light involving PHP, a programming language that is the basis for a large share of the internet.
